message.content:
Fix the shared-hosting security audit findings in worktree /opt/nxeon-wt-harden (branch feature/hosting-hardening). Do NOT deploy, do NOT touch any node, do NOT run prisma commands (verify with `npx tsc --noEmit`; treat "Property 'hostingX' does not exist" stale-client errors as noise — only fix real errors in your changes; node_modules is symlinked, NEVER run prisma generate). Commit when done; report exactly what you changed per finding. Follow every existing pattern; keep all shell-bound values validated.

Apply these fixes (they are precise — implement each):

**CRITICAL-1 — cross-tenant read via symlink.** In worker/hosting.ts, both `renderHostingVhost` and `renderSiteVhost`: add `disable_symlinks if_not_owner;` inside each `server` block that serves tenant content (so nginx refuses to follow a symlink whose target isn't owned by the same user — blocks a tenant symlinking to a victim's wp-config.php served by www-data). Put it alongside the `root`/`index` directives. Also in scripts/onboard-hosting-node.sh, assert kernel symlink protection: write `/etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon-hosting.conf` with `fs.protected_symlinks=1`, `fs.protected_hardlinks=1`, and `sysctl --system`.

**MEDIUM-1 — open_basedir prefix escape.** In lib/hosting.ts `fpmPoolConfig`, the `open_basedir` value must have TRAILING SLASHES on every component: `${home}/:/usr/share/php/` (not `${home}:/usr/share/php`). Without the slash, `/home/nxbob` also authorizes `/home/nxbob2/...`.

**MEDIUM-2 — PHP mail spam vector.** In lib/hosting.ts, the disabled-functions list (`PHP_DISABLED_FUNCTIONS` / `phpDisableFunctions`): add `mb_send_mail`, `imap_open`, `imap_mail` if not present (mail is already blocked; mb_send_mail is an equivalent wrapper). Keep the existing entries.

**HIGH-2 — no inode cap / DoS containment.**
- worker/hosting.ts: the `setquota -u ${u} ${softBlocks} ${hardBlocks} 0 0 /home` call sets inode limits to `0 0` = UNLIMITED. Change the trailing `0 0` to real inode limits — add a per-plan/default inode soft/hard (e.g. soft 200000, hard 250000; or scale off the disk quota). Read lib/hosting.ts `diskQuotaBlocks`/quota helpers and add an inode-limit helper in the same tested style, then use it.
- scripts/onboard-hosting-node.sh: (a) add an nproc/process cap for tenant users via `/etc/security/limits.d/99-nxeon-hosting.conf` (a fork-bomb via cron must not exhaust host PIDs — e.g. a sane hard `nproc` cap; scope carefully so it doesn't break root/system users — target the tenant uid range or a tenants group if one exists, else a conservative global soft/hard that won't hit system daemons); (b) remount/mount the `/home` loopback (the `nxeon-hosting-home.service` mount) with `nosuid,nodev` added to its existing options; (c) consider `noexec` on `/home` — but ONLY if it won't break PHP/WordPress (PHP is interpreted so FPM is fine; but some apps exec helpers — if unsure, add `noexec` to `/home/*/tmp` conceptually via a note, don't broadly noexec /home). Keep every step idempotent + `nginx -t`/guarded where relevant.

**MEDIUM-3 — download OOM.** lib/hosting-fs.ts `fsReadBuffer` buffers the whole file (`Buffer.concat`). In app/api/hosting/files/route.ts GET handler: enforce a max download size (stat first, reject over a cap like 100MB) and/or stream the SFTP read stream to the response instead of buffering. Pick the smaller-diff safe option (a size cap + existing buffer is acceptable if streaming is too invasive; prefer streaming if clean).

**LOW-1 — impersonation reveal.** lib/actions-hosting.ts: add `await assertNotImpersonating();` to `revealHostingSftpPassword` (and to `listHostingTasks` if it returns one-time WordPress admin passwords to the caller), matching orderHostingAccount/createHostingDatabase.

**Defense-in-depth (do if clean):** in scripts/onboard-hosting-node.sh, add global sshd hardening for tenants (`AllowTcpForwarding no`, `PermitTunnel no` — via the existing sshd_config.d drop-in, sshd -t guarded), and a note/echo listing what an operator must verify before marking the node ONLINE (quota enforcing, ModSecurity loaded, malware cron present).

tsc clean (ignoring stale-client noise), commit with a clear message summarizing each finding fixed, and report.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	#
3	# Prepare a Debian/Ubuntu box to be a Nxeon SHARED-HOSTING node, so the worker
4	# provisioner (worker/hosting.ts) can create isolated customer accounts on it.
5	# Idempotent — safe to re-run. Run as root ON THE SHARED BOX (not the panel).
6	#
7	#   bash onboard-hosting-node.sh
8	#
9	# What it sets up (the provisioner assumes all of this):
10	#   - nginx + php-fpm (8.3) + mariadb-server
11	#   - an nginx include dir for per-account vhosts (sites-enabled/*)
12	#   - a php-fpm pool include dir (/etc/php/8.3/fpm/pool.d already exists)
13	#   - disk QUOTA enabled on the filesystem holding /home (usrquota)
14	#   - fail2ban (sshd + a basic nginx jail)
15	#   - a default catch-all vhost so an unmatched Host header does NOT leak the
16	#     first account's site (name-based hosting hazard)
17	#
18	# SECURITY: this box will run many customers' PHP side by side. Before selling,
19	# also layer ModSecurity + a malware scanner (ImunifyAV / clamav) and review the
20	# per-account isolation the provisioner applies (open_basedir, disable_functions,
21	# nologin shell, socket perms). See worker/hosting.ts.
22	set -euo pipefail
23	
24	log() { printf '\033[1;36m[hosting-node]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
25	
26	export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
27	PHP_VER="${PHP_VER:-8.3}"
28	
29	log "Installing packages…"
30	apt-get update -y
31	apt-get install -y nginx mariadb-server "php${PHP_VER}-fpm" "php${PHP_VER}-mysql" \
32	  "php${PHP_VER}-cli" "php${PHP_VER}-curl" "php${PHP_VER}-gd" "php${PHP_VER}-mbstring" \
33	  "php${PHP_VER}-xml" "php${PHP_VER}-zip" quota fail2ban certbot python3-certbot-nginx curl >/dev/null
34	
35	log "Ensuring nginx include for per-account vhosts…"
36	mkdir -p /etc/nginx/sites-available /etc/nginx/sites-enabled /var/www/html
37	grep -q 'include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf || \
38	  sed -i '/http {/a \    include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*.conf;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
39	
40	log "Installing a default catch-all vhost (so an unmatched Host never leaks an account)…"
41	cat > /etc/nginx/sites-available/000-default-catchall.conf <<'EOF'
42	# Name-based hosting: a request whose Host matches no account must NOT fall
43	# through to whichever vhost nginx loaded first. This default_server absorbs them.
44	server {
45	    listen 80 default_server;
46	    listen [::]:80 default_server;
47	    server_name _;
48	    root /var/www/html;
49	    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root /var/www/html; }
50	    location / { return 404; }
51	}
52	EOF
53	ln -sfn /etc/nginx/sites-available/000-default-catchall.conf /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/000-default-catchall.conf
54	rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default 2>/dev/null || true
55	
56	log "Setting up ENFORCED disk quota for tenant homes…"
57	# Two gotchas make naive quota setup silently no-op on a stock Ubuntu cloud image
58	# (learned the hard way validating hosting-1, 2026-08-01):
59	#   1. The qfmt_v2 kernel module ships in linux-modules-extra, which the minimal
60	#      image omits — so ext4_enable_quotas fails with ESRCH and NOTHING enforces.
61	#   2. Enabling the ext4 quota FEATURE on the already-mounted root fs cannot be
62	#      done live, and doing it offline still leaves the quota inodes uninitialised.
63	# The reliable fix: install the modules, and back tenant homes with a DEDICATED
64	# loopback ext4 created WITH the quota feature (mkfs -O quota initialises the
65	# quota inodes properly). Idempotent.
66	DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y "linux-modules-extra-$(uname -r)" quota >/dev/null 2>&1 \
67	  || log "  WARNING: linux-modules-extra install failed — quota may not enforce"
68	depmod -a 2>/dev/null || true
69	modprobe qfmt_v2 2>/dev/null || true
70	
71	HOME_IMG=/var/lib/hosting-home.img
72	if ! mountpoint -q /home || ! quotaon -p /home 2>/dev/null | grep -qi ' is on'; then
73	  if [ ! -f "$HOME_IMG" ]; then
74	    FREE_G=$(df -BG --output=avail / | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9'); [ -z "$FREE_G" ] && FREE_G=20
75	    SZ=$(( FREE_G * 8 / 10 )); [ "$SZ" -lt 10 ] && SZ=10
76	    log "  creating ${SZ}G quota-enabled home filesystem…"
77	    fallocate -l "${SZ}G" "$HOME_IMG" 2>/dev/null || dd if=/dev/zero of="$HOME_IMG" bs=1M count=$((SZ*1024)) status=none
78	    mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O quota "$HOME_IMG"
79	  fi
80	  # Migrate any existing /home content in, then mount the loopback over /home.
81	  TMP=/var/lib/hosting-home.mnt; mkdir -p "$TMP"
82	  mount -o loop,usrquota,grpquota "$HOME_IMG" "$TMP" && { cp -a /home/. "$TMP/" 2>/dev/null || true; umount "$TMP"; }
83	  mount -o loop,usrquota,grpquota "$HOME_IMG" /home
84	fi
85	# Persist the mount via a systemd unit, NOT fstab: a loop+quota mount in fstab
86	# runs too early (before the loop device / quota module are ready) and silently
87	# fails, dropping quota on every reboot. This oneshot runs after local-fs and
88	# before the web services, and was verified to survive reboots on hosting-1.
89	cat > /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-hosting-home.service <<UNIT
90	[Unit]
91	Description=Nxeon shared-hosting tenant-home quota mount
92	After=local-fs.target
93	Before=nginx.service php${PHP_VER}-fpm.service mariadb.service
94	ConditionPathExists=$HOME_IMG
95	
96	[Service]
97	Type=oneshot
98	RemainAfterExit=yes
99	ExecStart=/bin/sh -c "mountpoint -q /home || mount -o loop,usrquota,grpquota $HOME_IMG /home"
100	ExecStart=/bin/sh -c "modprobe qfmt_v2 2>/dev/null || true; quotaon /home 2>/dev/null || true"
101	
102	[Install]
103	WantedBy=multi-user.target
104	UNIT
105	# Make sure any stale fstab loop line from an earlier version can't fight the unit.
106	sed -i "\#$HOME_IMG#d" /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null || true
107	systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now nxeon-hosting-home.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
108	quotaon /home 2>/dev/null || true
109	if quotaon -p /home 2>/dev/null | grep -qi ' is on'; then
110	  log "  disk quota is ACTIVE on /home."
111	else
112	  log "  ERROR: disk quota is NOT active on /home — a tenant could fill the node. Do NOT sell hosting here until fixed."
113	fi
114	
115	log "Basic fail2ban (sshd + nginx)…"
116	cat > /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/nxeon-hosting.conf <<'EOF'
117	[sshd]
118	enabled = true
119	[nginx-http-auth]
120	enabled = true
121	EOF
122	systemctl enable --now fail2ban >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
123	
124	log "Hardening: ModSecurity WAF + ClamAV malware scanner (shared-box essentials)…"
125	# ModSecurity for nginx with the OWASP core rule set — a shared box runs many
126	# customers' PHP; a WAF blocks the common exploit traffic before it reaches them.
127	apt-get install -y libnginx-mod-http-modsecurity modsecurity-crs clamav clamav-freshclam >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
128	  log "  ModSecurity/ClamAV packages not all available on this release — install manually before selling."
129	if [ -f /etc/modsecurity/modsecurity.conf-recommended ]; then
130	  mkdir -p /etc/nginx/modsec
131	  [ -f /etc/nginx/modsec/modsecurity.conf ] || cp /etc/modsecurity/modsecurity.conf-recommended /etc/nginx/modsec/modsecurity.conf

# Belt-and-braces with nginx `disable_symlinks if_not_owner` (worker/hosting.ts):

cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon-hosting.conf <<'SYSCTL'

# domain  type   item    value
*         soft   nproc   256
*         hard   nproc   400
root      soft   nproc   unlimited
root      hard   nproc   unlimited

content.text:
All fixes applied, tsc clean (0 errors), shell syntax valid, committed as `8fa5fcf` on `feature/hosting-hardening`.

## What changed per finding

**CRITICAL-1 — cross-tenant read via symlink**
- `worker/hosting.ts`: added `disable_symlinks if_not_owner;` alongside `root`/`index` in the shared `body` block of both `renderHostingVhost` and `renderSiteVhost` (so it lands in every tenant-serving `server` block, HTTP + HTTPS).
- `scripts/onboard-hosting-node.sh`: writes `/etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon-hosting.conf` with `fs.protected_symlinks=1` + `fs.protected_hardlinks=1`, then `sysctl --system`.

**MEDIUM-1 — open_basedir prefix escape**
- `lib/hosting.ts` `fpmPoolConfig`: `open_basedir` is now `${home}/:/usr/share/php/` (trailing slashes on both components).

**MEDIUM-2 — PHP mail spam vector**
- `lib/hosting.ts` `PHP_DISABLED_FUNCTIONS`: added `mb_send_mail`, `imap_open`, `imap_mail` (grouped with the existing `mail`); all prior entries kept.

**HIGH-2 — no inode cap / DoS containment**
- `lib/hosting.ts`: new tested `diskQuotaInodes(diskGB)` helper in the same style as `diskQuotaBlocks` (scales ~50k/GB, floor 200k, ceil 2M, hard = soft×1.25).
- `worker/hosting.ts`: `setquota` trailing `0 0` replaced with real `${inodes.soft} ${inodes.hard}`; imported the new helper.
- `scripts/onboard-hosting-node.sh`: (a) `/etc/security/limits.d/99-nxeon-hosting.conf` nproc cap `256/400` for `*` with root left unlimited — scoped via pam_limits so systemd daemons (mariadb/nginx/php-fpm) are untouched; (b) `/home` loopback now mounted `nosuid,nodev` (initial migrate mount, primary mount, systemd unit ExecStart, plus a live `remount` for already-mounted boxes); (c) a note explaining `/home` is deliberately not blanket-`noexec` (per-tenant `tmp` is the safe scope) rather than breaking apps that exec helpers.
